name: Hudson West
strengths: West stands tall in the shotgun and sees over the line with a high ready point.
West keeps his eyes downfield when the edge climbs and still finds the intermediate window.
West delivers a clean high release to the perimeter from an upright platform.
weaknesses: West still needs to fill out the 6-5 / 190 frame before he can win with mass in a college pocket.
comparison: West comps to Joe Flacco — 6-5 / 6-6 tall pocket mold; stands up, sees the field, and delivers from height.
projection: West projects as a Year 2–3 campus starter (develop and compete Year 1). Ceiling: multi-year SEC starter — the tall pocket QB who wins from height and takes the keys once the frame catches the traits.
schemeFit: West fits a pocket-progression QB room that values height, platform, and eyes over the line.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-02. Charles confirmed Flacco mold + QB-room projection path in Beat Desk session.
recruitingStory: Hudson West is a 2028 Sarasota QB and Florida target with a UF offer and multiple unofficial visits.
angle: Lead with stand-tall 6-5 pocket tape (height + eyes) and Florida process (Craddock offer, three UOVs). Flacco mold for size/traits — never rotational-QB language.
insiderNotes: West is a tall 6-5 pocket QB who stands up, sees over the line, and delivers from a high ready point. Eyes stay downfield when the edge climbs; release is clean to the perimeter. Wins with height, platform, and intermediate vision — a pocket-progression mold as the frame fills.
